subject: SE + Customer Eng alignment — finalize demo window & pre-demo checklist
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@stellarnet.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SE + Customer Eng alignment — finalize demo window & pre-demo checklist

Hi Sam — great to meet earlier this week. We're excited to walk StellarNet's infra and app team through a focused technical demo of Redwood inference. To keep this tight and productive, Priyom (SE) and Karthik (platform eng lead) will join from our side. A few asks up-front so we pick the right slot and prep correctly:

- Ideal attendees: your customer engineers, one security contact, and procurement for any PO questions.
- Proposed demo length: 45 minutes (30m demo + 15m Q&A/next steps).
- Proposed windows (PST):
  • Tue 18 May — 09:30–10:15 or 15:00–15:45
  • Wed 19 May — 11:00–11:45 or 16:00–16:45
  • Fri 21 May — 10:00–10:45

Can you confirm which of those work for your eng/security team? Also attaching a short pre-demo checklist (attachment) that lists network/IP whitelisting and temporary token access we sometimes ask for during the session. If you prefer a different cadence (longer deep-dive with a sandbox), let me know and we can adjust.

Thanks — I'll hold tentative calendar blocks until I hear back.

—Michael
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[michael.grant@redwood.com]

Attachments: pre-demo-checklist.pdf

Cc: Lisa Kim <lisa.kim@stellarnet.com>, Procurement <purchasing@stellarnet.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SE + Customer Eng alignment — finalize demo window & pre-demo checklist

Thanks Michael — appreciate the checklist. Quick notes from our side:

- Our engineers are available: Wed 19 May 16:00–16:45 works best (PST). Two backend engineers (Sam & Arjun) + Lisa (security) will join.
- Procurement can join the calendar hold but will only engage once we move toward PO. Purchasing suggested earliest PO review is week of 24 May.
- We reviewed the checklist: whitelisting will need a CIDR range (we can add on our side), but we’ll need your SOC2 / 3rd-party security excerpt for review before granting any elevated access.

Can you send over the SOC2 excerpt and a final calendar invite for Wed 19th 16:00 PST?

—Sam
Senior Platform Engineer, StellarNet

Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SE + Customer Eng alignment — finalize demo window & pre-demo checklist

Perfect — Wed 19 May 16:00 PST works for me. Short agenda proposal:

1) 0–5m: Intros + success criteria (Michael)
2) 5–25m: Live demo of inferencing flow + latency/cost controls (Priyom)
3) 25–35m: Deep-dive on network and auth requirements (Karthik)
4) 35–45m: Q&A and next steps (All)

Sam — two quick asks so the demo can be hands-on:
- If you can pre-whitelist these IPs for the 45-minute window: 34.82.10.12/32 and 34.82.10.13/32 (we'll also fall back to a screen-share-only mode if that's not possible).
- If you can share a short read-only dataset or example request pattern (screenshot or curl) ahead of time, we can tailor the demo to hit your perf characteristics.

Attaching the pre-demo checklist and a short calendar .ics I created so you can drop the slot into your team calendars. Also attaching a short SOC2 excerpt (redacted) to start your procurement/security review.

Thanks — looking forward.

—Priyom
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: pre-demo-checklist.pdf; redwood-se-availability.ics; soc2-excerpt-2026.pdf

Hi Michael — purchasing will hold a tentative calendar block on Wed 19 May 16:00–16:45 PST. A couple of notes:

- We typically do an initial commercial review after we see the technical fit. Please send high-level pricing bands or a link to the pricing sheet so we can prepare the internal PO template.
- If the demo proceeds to an evaluation, we'll request a standard mutual NDA and then our purchasing team will provide standard PO terms.

If there are any pre-demo materials for procurement (SOW template, pricing ranges), please attach or paste links and we'll circulate internally.

Thanks,
Purchasing Team
StellarNet
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@stellarnet.com>, Procurement <purchasing@stellarnet.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Thanks all — locking Wed 19 May 16:00–16:45 PST (calendar invite sent). Quick summary & next steps so we’re aligned:

- Confirmed attendees: Sam, Arjun (StellarNet engs), Lisa (security), Purchasing (tentative). Redwood: Priyom (SE), Karthik (platform), Michael (AE).
- Agenda: per Priyom's outline (30m demo, 15m Q&A).
- Pre-demo items for StellarNet: add 34.82.10.12/32 and 34.82.10.13/32 to whitelist for the session OR inform us if you prefer screen-share only; share a short example request pattern by EOD Tue 18 May.
- Procurement: Michael attached a high-level pricing summary and our SOW template in the HubSpot link — please review prior to PO conversation.
- Security: Priyom attached a redacted SOC2 excerpt earlier; full SOC2 report available under NDA — happy to coordinate with Lisa.

If anything changes, reply-all and we'll adjust. Looking forward to the session.

—Michael
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
